verdict.rationale: Apify documents running a scraper Actor such as apify/web-scraper on a start URL through one client `call()` that starts the Actor and waits for it to finish. Results come back as dataset items fetched separately, and nothing in the pack shows the raw page HTML being returned. missing for 10: documented raw-HTML output, a true single-request scrape endpoint that returns content inline, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scrape a web page with a single API call and get its raw HTML back
